h3.a: IMO Secretary-General calls on States to enforce maritime rules in the Strait of Hormuz

div.p: Secretary-General urges concrete measures to ensure compliance with international maritime regulations

h3.a: IMO Council urges stronger protection of seafarers amid threats to global shipping

div.p: Council condemns attacks on merchant shipping in the Red Sea and Black Sea, mourns loss of 25th seafarer since onset of Strait of Hormuz conflict, and renews Secretary-General’s tenure.

h3.a: IMO Council backs second term for Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez

div.p: Decision to extend the Secretary-General’s mandate for another four years is subject to approval by the IMO Assembly in 2027.

h3.a: Dalian Maritime University's Yu Jiajia to receive 2027 IMO Gender Equality Award

div.p: From the bridge to the classroom, Ms Yu has helped build a more inclusive maritime sector in China, serving as a role model for the global maritime community.
